script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. CUBICLE FARM - DAY

JENNY, a young PROGRAMMER with a determined look, types at her computer with unrelenting focus. She wears glasses and has her dark hair pulled into a messy bun. A small clock ticks away on her monitor, the second hand a frantic blur.

NARRATION (V.O.) (Jenny)
Today, I'm going to prove them all wrong. Today, I'm going to save my project. Today, I'm going to get my second chance.

INT. BREAK ROOM - DAY

Jenny sits at a table, eating a sandwich. PAUL, a friendly but sarcastic COLLEAGUE, enters. He sets a tray of coffee and donuts down in front of her.

PAUL
You've got your game face on today, huh?

JENNY
(smiling)
Just trying to meet the deadline.

PAUL
I've got some extra time if you want to bounce ideas off each other.

JENNY
(grateful)
I'd love that.

INT. CUBICLE FARM - DAY

Jenny and Paul work together, collaborating on the project. As they discuss solutions, Jenny's confidence grows. She begins to believe in her abilities.

INT. BOSS'S OFFICE - DAY

Mr. HENRY, a stern but fair BOSS, watches Jenny and Paul through the office window. He nods to himself, satisfied.

INT. CUBICLE FARM - DAY

Jenny and Paul have successfully completed the project. They celebrate with a team lunch in the break room.

JENNY
(smiling)
We did it!

PAUL
We sure did. And I couldn't have done it without you.

JENNY
(grateful)
You've been a huge help, Paul.

INT. CUBICLE FARM - NIGHT

Jenny works late into the night, polishing up the final details of the project. As she finishes, she saves the file and stands up, stretching. She looks around her cubicle, taking pride in her work.

NARRATION (V.O.) (Jenny)
I did it. I proved them all wrong. And I got my second chance.

EXT. OFFICE PARKING LOT - NIGHT

Jenny exits the building, the moon casting a silver glow over the landscape. She takes a deep breath, feeling a sense of accomplishment.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
